# Topsoil

> Topsoil is a native macOS menu bar app that turns the MacBook camera
> cutout (the notch) into a live dashboard: coding agent terminals (Claude,
> Codex, Cursor), now playing with lyrics, quick toggles, timers, a drop shelf
> for local files, stocks, and GitHub trends. Built with Swift 6 and SwiftUI,
> no Electron, no accounts, no telemetry. Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later on
> Apple silicon. Works on Macs without a notch by docking to the top of any
> display.

## Facts

- Three default pages: Quick (media, toggles, timers, actions, drop shelf),
  Code (Claude, Codex, Cursor terminal panes), Stocks (tickers, trending
  repositories, installed coding skills).
- Optional modules: Screen Time, Pomodoro, Reminders, Calendar, Clipboard,
  Battery and System, Launcher, Command Palette, Notch Garden, Customize.
- The panel never covers the camera or privacy light; it reads the screen
  safe area insets and paints around the hardware.
- User files never leave the Mac. Optional modules fetch public data only
  (market quotes, GitHub trending, lyrics).
- Download: https://github.com/Davey2Waveyy/MacNotch/releases/latest

## Pages

- [Home](index.html): product overview, live demo video, page gallery, specs, FAQ.
- [Privacy](privacy.html): what the app and site do and do not collect.
